Metadata.Title: Polish bro's MGS series 9
Metadata.Description: Greetings everyone, Polish bro here.The operation in Marrakesh dealt a heavy blow to Golden Crescent, but the organization refused to collapse. ICA has tracked its surviving leaders to Miami, where they are using the Global Innovation Race as cover to negotiate new partnerships, secure funding, and recruit influential allies.Your mission is to eliminate every target before Golden Crescent can rise again.Let's ensure their future ends at the finish line.Good hunting, MFs.
